title: Capacity Prioritization Board: rotational microteam hedging (pilot)
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: mid-cycle we repeatedly overcommit on initiatives and then perform blunt scope cuts that harm momentum on high-ROI infra work (runtime/observability). The team needs a lightweight operational mechanism to: 1) reserve a small rolling capacity buffer, 2) make rapid, cross-functional de-scope decisions, and 3) measure the cost of pauses vs. feature slippage.

Proposal: run a 3-cycle pilot of a Capacity Prioritization Board (CPB) — a 4-person rotating panel (PM, Eng lead, Design lead, Infra steward) that meets weekly to manage a 10% reserve band. The CPB will: (a) allocate reserve credits to requests, (b) enforce a fast de-scope flow for low-ranked work, and (c) maintain a small backlog hedging pool for unplanned incidents. We will pilot with two squads and one infra stream.

Goals and success metrics: 
- Reduce mid-cycle emergency scope cuts that affect infra by 60% (compare last 3 cycles baseline).
- Keep sprint-level unplanned work within the 10% reserve band for 80% of board decisions.
- Reduce cycle rollovers of committed PM initiatives by 25% across pilot squads.

Outcomes expected: clearer tradeoff visibility, fewer ad-hoc firefights, and a replicable playbook for scaling to the org.

Tradeoffs: adds weekly governance overhead and requires discipline in auxiliary teams to submit triage forms. Risk of underutilizing reserve credits if board is too conservative.

Dependencies: usage telemetry from Cycle Tracker dashboard (engineered by Eng infra), capacity projection model (Data product), and two committed squad leads for the pilot window.

Artifacts: initial PRD in Confluence (link below), draft triage form, and the simulation notebook we used to model reserve behaviour.
acceptance_criteria: CPB charter accepted by Eng, Design, and PM leadership (documented in Confluence)
Reserve credit ledger and simple UI prototype available for weekly use (hand-off version in Drive)
Two squads and one infra stream onboarded and running weekly CPB triage for at least two sprints
Baseline metrics captured and first-cycle comparison report produced
steps: Build minimal reserve ledger (spreadsheet -> low-fi UI) and triage intake form (week 1)
Onboard pilot squads; run weekly 30-min CPB cadence (weeks 2-9)
Capture metrics each sprint and run a mid-pilot review (end of week 5)
Iterate on thresholds and automations; produce roll-forward playbook (week 10)
